## Fewer clicks with the Claude app
- Claude now reaches Ignite3D through **one tool**, so you choose **Always allow** once and never get asked again.
- If the Ignite3D extension is installed in the Claude app, the older direct link is removed automatically, so Claude doesn't see Ignite3D twice.
- Get the updated extension from the repo: `extension/Ignite3D.mcpb`.
